title: THEATER SELECTION
subtitle: Choose a theater to begin your campaign. Five desks are free.

theaters.description: Pacific naval pressure as Port Arthur falls and great-power desks recalibrate.
theaters.objectives: Contain the Far East shock without collapsing European credibility.
theaters.challenges: Fleet losses, alliance optics, and market panic from Asian war news.
theaters.intel: Sea of Japan and Manchurian markers open the Pacific desk.

theaters.description: Belgium and northern France as the Schlieffen timetable opens.
theaters.objectives: Hold the Channel ports narrative. Limit escalation while preserving coalition credibility.
theaters.challenges: Rail timetables, Belgian neutrality optics, and market panic from partial mobilization.
theaters.intel: Capitals and frontier districts form the primary decision surface.

theaters.description: Mandate diplomacy across Palestine, London desks, and wartime Arab alliances.
theaters.region: Palestine · London · Arab Revolt · wartime diplomacy
theaters.objectives: Balance wartime promises without unlocking uncontrolled escalation in the Levant.
theaters.challenges: Mandate claims, revolt networks, and London desk pressure.
theaters.intel: Levant and Anatolian markers unlock as phases advance.

theaters.description: The eastern empire strains as fronts, capitals, and armies fracture.
theaters.objectives: Stabilize credibility across allied desks without collapsing home-front STAB.
theaters.challenges: Multi-capital pressure, refugee toll, and alliance coordination lag.
theaters.intel: Eastern rail hubs and capital markers drive escalation risk.

theaters.description: Allied settlement desks reshape borders after the Central Powers collapse.
theaters.region: Paris · Allied capitals · defeated Central Powers
theaters.objectives: Secure a durable peace table without seeding the next crisis.
theaters.challenges: Reparations optics, minority corridors, and domestic politics at home.
theaters.intel: Paris and defeated-capital markers shape the settlement map.

theaters.description: Allied occupation zones and Anatolian resistance reshape Near East mandates.
theaters.objectives: Manage occupation optics while avoiding a wider Near East war.
theaters.challenges: Zone disputes, Aegean stakes, and mandate bargaining.
theaters.intel: Anatolia and Aegean corridors unlock under stress.

theaters.description: New York and London credit desks face a cascading market shock.
theaters.objectives: Contain panic without sacrificing long-term credibility.
theaters.challenges: Bank runs, cross-Atlantic contagion, and political blame.
theaters.intel: Market markers pulse as credit corridors seize.

theaters.description: Manchuria and League desks collide as East Asia militarizes.
theaters.region: Manchuria · League of Nations · East Asia
theaters.objectives: Preserve League credibility without inviting a Pacific war.
theaters.challenges: Incident fog, occupation facts, and Alliance hesitation.
theaters.intel: Mukden and League markers define the hour.

theaters.description: Czechoslovakia and Western capitals bargain under German pressure.
theaters.objectives: Buy time without surrendering the alliance narrative.
theaters.challenges: Appeasement optics, military unreadiness, and domestic politics.
theaters.intel: Prague and Western capital markers dominate the window.

theaters.description: Poland and Allied capitals face an ultimatum over Danzig corridors.
theaters.objectives: Signal resolve without triggering immediate general war.
theaters.challenges: Guarantee credibility, mobilization clocks, and public opinion.
theaters.intel: Corridor and capital markers decide the first phase.

theaters.description: Embargo desks and Pacific coordination push the United States toward war.
theaters.objectives: Coordinate Allied response without losing the Atlantic focus.
theaters.challenges: Oil embargoes, fleet basing, and coalition lag.
theaters.intel: Pacific and embargo markers unlock the threshold.

theaters.description: Pacific endgame — Allied high command weighs the final weapons choice.
theaters.objectives: End the war while managing moral and strategic credibility costs.
theaters.challenges: Casualty forecasts, Soviet entry, and domestic politics.
theaters.intel: Trinity and Pacific command markers close the theater.

theaters.description: India and Pakistan partition along the Radcliffe Award under extreme time pressure.
theaters.region: India · Pakistan · Punjab · Bengal · Radcliffe Award
theaters.objectives: Limit civilian toll while preserving international credibility.
theaters.challenges: Boundary fog, refugee corridors, and communal violence risk.
theaters.intel: Punjab and Bengal markers drive the partition map.

theaters.description: Western Europe reconstruction desks bargain over ERP aid and alignment.
theaters.objectives: Secure recovery without locking allies into dependency optics.
theaters.challenges: Aid conditionality, Soviet reaction, and Congress politics.
theaters.intel: Washington and European capital markers shape the bargain.

theaters.description: Two Korean states form along the 38th Parallel occupation line.
theaters.region: Korean Peninsula · 38th Parallel · occupation zones · state founding
theaters.objectives: Stabilize the peninsula without inviting immediate war.
theaters.challenges: Recognition politics, occupation zones, and great-power patronage.
theaters.intel: 38th Parallel markers define the founding crisis.

theaters.description: China and Taiwan Strait recognition desks rewrite East Asian alignment.
theaters.objectives: Manage recognition without collapsing allied credibility in Asia.
theaters.challenges: Two-China optics, Strait military risk, and UN seats.
theaters.intel: Beijing and Taipei markers unlock the mandate question.

theaters.description: UN Command and the 38th Parallel become an active combat theater.
theaters.region: Korean War · UN Command · 38th Parallel combat
theaters.objectives: Contain the war without triggering wider great-power escalation.
theaters.challenges: Inchon gambles, Chinese intervention risk, and domestic patience.
theaters.intel: Parallel combat markers pulse through each phase.

theaters.description: Suez, UN desks, and financial markets collide over canal control.
theaters.region: Suez · Middle East · UN · financial markets
theaters.objectives: Restore access without destroying alliance credibility.
theaters.challenges: Colonial optics, sterling crisis, and superpower pressure.
theaters.intel: Canal and UN markers define the crisis surface.

theaters.description: Caribbean and Atlantic nuclear command desks face a thirteen-day clock.
theaters.objectives: Remove the threat without nuclear exchange.
theaters.challenges: Blockade optics, back-channel diplomacy, and launch authority.
theaters.intel: Caribbean markers and command links dominate the map.

theaters.description: Warsaw Pact and Western capitals respond to the Prague Spring.
theaters.objectives: Support reform optics without inviting uncontrolled escalation.
theaters.challenges: Invasion clocks, alliance cohesion, and public solidarity.
theaters.intel: Prague and Pact markers shape the desk.

theaters.description: OPEC producers and consumer economies collide in an embargo shock.
theaters.objectives: Stabilize markets without surrendering strategic autonomy.
theaters.challenges: Price spikes, alliance friction, and domestic unrest.
theaters.intel: Gulf and market markers transmit the shock.

theaters.description: Iran, Gulf embassies, and alliance networks realign under revolution.
theaters.objectives: Protect personnel and credibility without a wider Gulf war.
theaters.challenges: Embassy risk, oil lanes, and regional patronage shifts.
theaters.intel: Tehran and Gulf markers unlock the pivot.

theaters.description: Berlin and Central Europe alliance desks navigate sudden opening.
theaters.objectives: Guide reunification optics without destabilizing Europe.
theaters.challenges: Pace of opening, Soviet reaction, and NATO cohesion.
theaters.intel: Berlin markers and corridor links define Wall Night.

theaters.description: Moscow, republics, and nuclear command face union dissolution.
theaters.objectives: Secure nuclear control while managing republic recognition.
theaters.challenges: Command authority, ethnic flashpoints, and Western aid optics.
theaters.intel: Moscow and republic markers drive the dissolution map.

theaters.description: Thailand, Indonesia, and Korea transmit a capital contagion shock.
theaters.objectives: Contain financial panic without collapsing regional credibility.
theaters.challenges: Currency pegs, IMF conditionality, and social unrest.
theaters.intel: Asian capital markers pulse as contagion spreads.
